title: Hokypoky penny a lump.
html_source:
‘Hokey-pokey’ was an American term for ice-cream, and particularly for cheap, inferior brands often sold on the streets by Italian vendors.

Possibly a corruption of “hoc est enim” from the phrase “hoc est enim corpus meum” (For this is my Body).
